viewUserGuide: The textarea below shows the file content. Refer to the user guide for syntax details. You can click the link to open the user guide in SiYuan.
indexIgnoreDesc: Syntax: gitignore wildcards. One rule per line; matched docs/assets are excluded from indexing.
searchIgnoreDesc: Syntax: SQL filter conditions. One condition per line; matched SQL conditions are excluded from global search.
refsearchIgnoreDesc: Syntax: SQL filter conditions. One condition per line; matched SQL conditions are excluded from reference search.
embeddingIgnoreDesc: Syntax: gitignore wildcards. One rule per line; matched docs/assets are excluded from embed model processing.
embeddingIgnoreVersionWarning: Current SiYuan version ({version}) is lower than the required version (3.7.0); this setting will not take effect.
syncIgnoreDesc: Syntax: gitignore wildcards. One rule per line; matched docs/assets are excluded from cloud syncing.
